title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via Marshal.load (ruby) — review required
description: In ruby, Marshal.load performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The ruby-specific remedy is data-only decoding via JSON parsing.
applicability: ruby codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through Marshal.load; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
